graders.name: reply
graders.evidence:
**Verdict: PROCEED.** I found no Blockers, but I need one decision from you before the planner step is complete.

**Decision needed:** the design has three different looks for the Today screen. Which one do you want?
- **Compact** (`/today-compact`): a tight list with small text and a "Done" link on each row.
- **Cards** (`/today-cards`): each reminder in its own white card with a big green "Done" button.
- **Timeline** (`/today-timeline`): a dark theme with a vertical line. Each reminder has "Done" and "Snooze" buttons.

If you pick Timeline, I'll also need to ask what to do with "Snooze". The backend has no way to snooze, so you'd choose between dropping the button and showing it disabled with a "coming soon" label. You can also send one screenshot of your chosen look, saved as `.ui-workflow/export/screenshots/Today.png`. That's optional.

**Checked against the backend:**
- **All reminders:** `title`, `due` and `done` come from `GET /api/reminders`. The Done button uses `POST /api/reminders/{id}/done`.
- **Done view:** the design's Done screen only needs the reminders whose `done` is true, which the browser can filter out of the same `GET /api/reminders` list. No new backend work is needed.
- **Settings:** it isn't part of the redesign, so it has no entry in the plan.

**Not checked:**
- I didn't read `app/templates/index.html` or `app/static/app.js`. The backend side comes from `app/main.py` only.
- The design never shows the `owner` name ("Lan") that the page template receives. I didn't check whether the current page uses it.

The plan is at `.ui-workflow/integration-plan.md`. `Completed steps` is unchanged. Once you've answered, re-run `/ui-workflow-skills:integration-planner`. After that, the next command is `/ui-workflow-skills:design-port`.
